subject: Customer DPA - FinTechCo: SCCs, HIPAA scope, signature routing
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechco.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Customer DPA - FinTechCo: SCCs, HIPAA scope, signature routing

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to kick off the DPA work so we can get this into our signature queue. A few things to confirm up front:

- We’ll need SCCs included (we have EU users, but primary data residency will be US).
- Can you confirm whether Redwood’s standard DPA covers HIPAA (we may need a BAA or HIPAA module for a subset of users)?
- FinTechCo requires a 12-month retention exception for aggregated analytics — would Redwood accept that by exception?

I’ve attached our security requirements spreadsheet for reference. Please send your redline and any SOC 2 evidence or pointer to the report. Also let me know who should sign on your side (legal or an authorized exec) and whether you prefer DocuSign.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Procurement Manager
FinTechCo

Attachment: FinTechCo_Security_Requirements.xlsx

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechco.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T11:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Customer DPA - FinTechCo: SCCs, HIPAA scope, signature routing

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the checklist. Attached is a Redwood redline of our standard DPA; key points up front:

- We can include SCCs via an EU Addendum (we typically include the addendum when EU data processing is material).
- HIPAA: Redwood offers an optional HIPAA module (BAA) for covered workflows; it’s an addendum rather than modifying base indemnities.
- Retention: our standard retention is 24 months for customer data; we can consider a 12-month exception for aggregated analytics. Marissa (cc’d) will confirm legal on that.

Who signs: we typically have an authorized signatory (VP Legal) countersign after customer signs; DocuSign is preferred. If procurement requires in-person signature, we can accommodate but prefer DocuSign for speed.

Next steps: Marissa will comment on legal redlines; if FinTechCo can send a single redline doc (or confirm the items you want accepted) we’ll drive to final.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_redline_20260115.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechco.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Customer DPA - FinTechCo: SCCs, HIPAA scope, signature routing

Alex / Emily —

I reviewed the redline and have the following comments from legal:

1) SCCs: we can include the EU Addendum; confirm whether FinTechCo wants controller-to-processor or controller-to-controller wording — our standard is controller-to-processor.
2) HIPAA: we treat HIPAA as an addendum (BAA). If FinTechCo requires HIPAA in scope, please specify the subsets of workloads and covered entities so we can scope subprocessors and security controls.
3) Data retention & deletion: request to limit the 12-month exception to aggregated, non-PII analytics. We will not accept a 12-month exception for raw personal data; propose language that explicitly excludes PII.
4) Subprocessors: we will provide a current subprocessors list; customer can request prior notice for changes and the right to object for specific subprocessors.
5) Indemnity & liability: we push back on expanding indemnities tied to third-party claims beyond direct damages.

I attached a short memo with suggested clause edits and rationale. If FinTechCo counters in a single document (track changes), that will speed the path to signature.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_LegalNotes_20260118.pdf

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@fintechco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Customer DPA - FinTechCo: SCCs, HIPAA scope, signature routing

Marissa / Alex —

Thanks for the quick review. We reviewed your notes internally and here’s where we are:

- SCCs: controller-to-processor is fine.
- HIPAA: we do need a BAA for the payments reconciliation dataset (covered entity is FinTechCo). I can highlight the tables/feeds that are in scope and share that with you later today.
- Retention: we accept the proposed language limiting the 12-month aggregated analytics exception to non-PII.
- Subprocessors: we’ll review your subprocessors list once provided; we don’t anticipate objections right now.
- Indemnity: we’ll accept Redwood’s position on direct damages but request language that covers regulatory fines specifically tied to Redwood’s breach of obligations.

Attached is FinTechCo’s single redline — I tried to consolidate comments into the document. Please confirm which changes you can accept. Also, who is the signatory on Redwood’s side? We’d like to route to our legal for countersignature once agreed.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Procurement Manager, FinTechCo

Attachment: FinTechCo_DPA_redline_20260119.docx

Emily / Rajiv —

Thanks for the updates and the consolidated redline. Based on Marissa’s memo and Karthik’s commercial sign-off, we’ve prepared a final DPA that incorporates: the controller-to-processor SCCs addendum, a scoped HIPAA BAA limited to the payments reconciliation dataset, and the 12-month aggregated analytics retention exception limited to non-PII.

I’ve attached the final DPA for review (Redwood_DPA_Final_20260122.docx) and a short SCCs checklist (SCCs_checklist.pdf).

Signature routing: we will send the DocuSign envelope to the FinTechCo signatory you confirmed (procurement@fintechco.com). Once FinTechCo signs, the envelope will route to Redwood’s authorized signatory (VP Legal). If DocuSign is blocked on your side, please reply-all with "ALTERNATE_SIGN" and we will provision a PDF for countersignature.

SOC 2 evidence: the current report and cover letter are available on request — I’ve sent a secure link to Rajiv separately.

Next steps:
- Emily: please confirm the primary FinTechCo signer and we’ll send DocuSign.
- Legal Ops: please hold for the envelope and prepare countersign records.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Final_20260122.docx; SCCs_checklist.pdf
